name: Chief
source:
Specialty: Baritsu, violin, swimming, pick-pocketing, golf, keepie uppie, lock picking, speaking without thinking, horsemanship, tennis
Hobby: Counting revenues and expenditures
Likes: Money, Sherlock Holmes series
Dislikes: Unhygienic conditions​

A British woman who runs the "Cherry Detective Office" in the imperial capital. Although she undertakes various projects ranging from finding lost items to affairs investigation, the office's financial situation is always in dire. Although her peculiar appearance often stands out, she doesn't seem to care.

"Well now, let's start the Resolution Part, shall we."

[spoiler]Her real name is Rebecca Kruger[/spoiler]
